meta.compatibility: Local skill-specification integration only; NOT a call to the hosted H3-Context-IR API.
meta.policy: Structure, field names, section order, and timing notation follow the official guide. No generic video prompt templates.

fl2va.alignment_instruction: How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark of the target video.
rules: State overall style and initial composition at the start of [Shot 1].
Describe composition, subjects, environment, actions, camera, and the exact point where referenced content appears.
Do not add a timestamp to the first shot; use [Shot N] with strictly increasing cut times for later shots.
Camera motion = motion type + amplitude + speed written as natural English within the shot.
overall_soundscape summarizes ambient, physical-action, and non-verbal human sounds.
non_diegetic_music describes background music only the audience hears.
Preserve reference-image consistency: geometry, material, lighting, and framing.
guardrails: No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.
Duration and motion timing must match the requested duration.

keywords.phrase: Very subtle aerial reveal framing
Aerial establishing shot, top-down drone perspective, wide framing
Cinematic wide hero shot of the exterior facade
Close-up shot with shallow depth of field
First-person interior walkthrough framing
Wide establishing framing

movement_types.dolly: glides forward on a gentle dolly

motion.temporal_consistency: Motion is continuous and temporally consistent across the clip; no jarring cuts in this single-shot sequence.

keywords.phrase: Lighting remains consistent with the reference image; no lighting transformation
Golden-hour daylight with warm directional illumination
Night scene with warm interior light spilling from windows and cool ambient moonlight
Bright natural daylight with even soft illumination
Post-rain atmosphere with clean reflective surfaces

lighting.default: Natural daylight with soft directional illumination

geometry.preservation: Architectural structure, proportions, and spatial relationships remain consistent with the reference image.

keywords.phrase: Building volume and massing are preserved exactly as in the reference
Geometry and structure stay consistent with the reference

material.texture_behavior: Materials keep their characteristic texture, reflectivity, and tactile behavior.

keywords.phrase: Concrete surfaces keep crisp board-formed texture
Glass reflects the surrounding sky and light with clean reflections
Timber surfaces show warm grain and natural tonal variation
Metal elements hold sharp highlights and fine surface finish

material.default: Material textures remain faithful to the reference

keywords.phrase: light atmospheric haze
clear air with crisp visibility
calm, contemplative mood
monumental, cinematic mood

atmosphere.environment_default: environment consistent with the reference site

soundscape_default: Gentle ambient environment sound consistent with the scene, subtle wind, and light spatial room tone; no dialogue.
music_default: Minimal ambient cinematic score, slow tempo, warm and restrained, fading in softly.
